verdict.rationale: Convex documents itself as a reactive database with real-time sync that pushes changes over WebSockets for live updates, so clients receive new data without polling (docs-1, docs-21, docs-40, docs-70). The CLI's --watch flag live-updates query results (docs-51), and a community commenter describes the function itself as the point of reactivity (comm-3). The HN question about 'smart polling' notes that Convex reruns the query server-side on overlapping writes, which is a design difference rather than evidence that clients poll. Missing for 10: detailed client subscription API docs (e.g., hooks or subscribe calls per framework), and hands-on corroboration of update latency and behavior.
